messages:
Dana: Tiny proposal  Ugly Tie & Cozy Scarf Day this Thursday at 4pm? Quick group photo for the wall of shame. :necktie::scarf:
Omar: Ha yes. I'll drag out the neon tie from last year. Warning: it's loud.
Lisa: Also tea swap? Bring a bag of your favorite tea and label it. We can have a small tasting table.
Ken: Count me in. I'll bring a box of peppermint rooibos and a kettle timer so we don't burn anybody's tea.
Facilities: Heads up  please don't block the corridor for photos. We'll clear a small corner by the kitchen seating.
SnackBot: Note: we've got sugar-free cookies available in the pantry. Labelled on the dish.
Dana: Quick rules: keep it inclusive (ties & scarves optional), no religious symbols, and keep the photo opt-in.
Priya: Remote folks can post a photo in the #random thread with their tie/scarf for the montage. We'll compile.
Omar: Meme idea: bring your worst holiday tie and write a 1-line backstory. Loser buys virtual coffee? :coffee:
Lisa: I volunteer to be paper-judge for the worst backstory. Also I'll make a tiny checklist for tea labels: name, steep time, caffeine.
Ken: Thumbs-up if you approve we share the photo montage in the all-company doc. Thumbs-down to keep private.
Dana: I'll screenshot thumbs in 2 hours and respect majority.
Facilities: We'll reserve the corner at 3:50 and set out a small stool for the photo.
Priya: Remote: DM me your photo by Thurs 3pm if you want in. I'll assemble.
Omar: Also if anyone wants to swap scarves after the event, let's do a "scarf circulate" box.
Lisa: Allergies note: avoid feathered accessories pls (some folks have allergies).
Ken: I'll add an event to the calendar: Thu 16:00-16:20  "Ugly Tie & Cozy Scarf Tea Swap". Short and sweet.
Dana: Perfect. Thanks team  can't wait to be judged for my tie choice. :grimacing:
SnackBot: Reminder set: Thu 15:45 - bring out sugar-free cookies and tea tray.
Priya: Montage consent check: react with :camera_with_flash: to allow montage share, :x: to decline.
Dana: :camera_with_flash:
Omar: :camera_with_flash:
Lisa: :camera_with_flash:
Ken: :camera_with_flash:
Facilities: :camera_with_flash:
Dana: All good then. See you Thursday  tiny, tasteful chaos incoming. :sparkles:
